svg.text: Figure 3. Level 0 Data Flow Diagram — Separate Processes
Validate and save a new account
Save changes to an existing product
Apply filters and display current stock
Summarize sales for the chosen period
Create and save a database snapshot
Validate access and restore saved data
Calculate line amounts and total due
Save the sale and purchased items
Cashier can view only their own sales
Record the requested work and charge
Repeated actors/stores are the same entities. Cashier history is limited to their own transactions.
*Labor and service records are retained from the earlier business DFD and are not in the supplied use case.
Rectangle = external entity | Numbered box = separate process | D1-D6 = logical data stores | Arrow = data flow
